youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Jeremiah 29:11 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. If your plans fell apart, hear this.

"For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end." Jeremiah 29:11 (KJV)

For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD,

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
